text:
alyssa: Quick follow-up from yesterday's obs schema session — thinking through a compact path for trace/metric correlation + cost attribution that doesn't blow up cardinality.

sanjay: +1, sounded like we were leaning away from full late enrichment for high-card cohorts. what's the concrete ask?

alyssa: Proposal: add a 16-byte base64 "ctx_token" at envelope root that encodes minimal attribution (tenant shard, sampling cohort id, cost_bucket). Keep it immutable as it travels; downstream can expand to full attributes via a lookup service only when needed.

meera: That sounds promising. Does ctx_token replace billing keys or supplement?

alyssa: Supplement. Billing-key stays for accuracy, ctx_token is for fast joins in high-QPS paths.

marco: What's the encoding? example?

alyssa: ```
{
  "ctx_token": "ABCD...==",
  "kind": "envelope",
  "payload": "...",
  "meta": {"sample": "heuristic-v2"}
}
```

sanjay: How do we handle schema migration? older agents won't send it.

alyssa: Two-phase: 1) Edge proxies inject a generated ctx_token if missing (derived from tenant id + sampler) and flag it with meta.injected=true. 2) Consumers read token if present. Gradual rollout.

rahul: Concern: lookup service becomes hot. If many consumers call to expand token for cost billing, it's extra load.

meera: We could cache expansions at the consumer side for 5m TTL keyed by token hash, and also support a bulk refresh endpoint.

julia: What about deletion/rotation? If tenant mapping changes, how do we prevent stale cost attributions?

alyssa: token includes a 24-hour epoch id so tokens are short-lived by default; we can bump epoch on reassignments. Rotation strategy avoids locked-in stale attributions.

sanjay: Edge-case: replays/amplification. If proxies add token for offline/ingest replays, we might misattribute.

alyssa: Good call — proxies should set meta.replay_hint=true for offline replays and ingestion pipeline will treat those tokens as advisory only (needs billing-key corroboration).

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: obs-proxy v3.12 -> staging at 2026-04-02 03:00 UTC :rocket:

marco: Action items: 1) draft proxy inject patch (meera), 2) token spec doc (alyssa), 3) consumer cache strategy (rahul). Agree?

meera: I'll pair with infra on patch by EOD Friday.

rahul: I'll prototype cache with 2s lookup + 5m TTL; will share perf numbers.

julia: I'll draft migration notes for billing team — include fallback to billing-key for final invoicing.

alyssa: Thanks. If no objections, I'll open RFC PR linking this thread. @sanjay @marco flag anything missing.

sanjay: One more: add a metric for "token_expansion_failures" and "injected_token_rate" so we can monitor adoption.

alyssa: Good call — added to action list.
